comparison.objective: Sort six kitchen items into municipal waste categories, including handoffs and leaving a smartphone untouched; candidate tunes a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Semantic classification, pick-place, and cross-arm handoff versus tool-mediated release, fine rotational adjustment, relocking, and impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Correct bin assignment and preserved smartphone versus numeric stopping behavior, no damage, and setting retention.
comparison.reason: Generic grasping does not make semantic waste sorting overlap damper commissioning.
